summary: Fixed two bugs in CollageMaker: (1) Main canvas not rendering after image upload - caused by accessing base.canvasRenderer directly instead of using base.getCanvasRenderer(). Fixed by updating createCollageMethods.js to use the getter. (2) Crop Editor sidebar showing blank when selecting a panel - caused by missing call to _scheduleCropPreviewRender() and DOM timing issues. Fixed by adding _scheduleCropPreviewRender() in selectPanel handler and wrapping it in this.$nextTick() to wait for Vue's DOM updates. Verified through browser automation that images now render on main canvas and crop preview displays correctly with overlay.
key_decisions: Use base.getCanvasRenderer() instead of direct property access
Wrap DOM-dependent operations in $nextTick() to ensure Vue has finished DOM updates
challenges: Debugging async Vue reactivity timing issues
Identifying that canvas element didn't exist in DOM when crop preview render was called
